Signup.heading: Lets begin your journey
Signup.description: Create your profile, then tell us a bit more about yourself and your immigration plans.
Signup.subheadingProfile: Please complete your profile details first so we can assess your case accurately.

credentials.title: First, create your login
credentials.subtitle: Use these details to sign in later. You can complete your profile after.

passportPlans.title: Passport and plans in South Africa

cityCountry.label: Country and city of residence
cityCountry.placeholder: e.g. Moscow, Russia / Cape Town, South Africa

familyComposition.label: Family members and ages
familyComposition.placeholder: Spouse, children, dependants and their ages.

incomeSource.label: Main source of income
incomeSource.placeholder: Employment, own business, pension, rental income, dividends, etc.
incomeSource.hint: You can choose more than one source when we discuss your case in detail.

beenToSa.label: Have you been to South Africa before?

firstEntrySa.label: If yes, month and year of first entry to South Africa

currentLocation.label: Where are you currently located?
currentLocation.placeholder: Country and city at the time of filling in this form

currentVisa.label: If you are already in South Africa, which visa do you hold?
currentVisa.placeholder: Type of visa, validity period and start date.

visaRefusals.label: Any previous visa refusals for South Africa?

visitPurpose.label: Purpose of your stay in South Africa
visitPurpose.placeholder: What do you plan to do in South Africa (work, study, business, retirement, etc.)?

needLanguageSchool.label: Do you need help selecting a language school?
